name: Independent Means / Passive-Income Residency

requirements.blocker_text: No officially published minimum income figure was found in this build; immigration-services sources converge informally around USD 1,300/month for a single applicant plus USD 500 per dependent. Qualifying income: pensions, rental income, dividends/investment interest, stable savings or annuities, trust/inheritance income. Local employment, freelance work, or self-employment originating in Paraguay does NOT qualify (unless formally registered as a business, which would instead fall under a different residency category). Since Resolution DNM 407/2026 (effective June 2026), a diploma or bare claim is no longer sufficient -- applicants relying on foreign-sourced income must now provide apostilled employer attestations, service contracts, or payment statements documenting that income as real and ongoing.
requirements.fix_path: Document stable foreign-sourced passive income (pension, rental, dividend, or similar) with apostilled and translated supporting evidence, then apply for Temporary Residency at DNM.

evidence_required.document: Apostilled proof of passive foreign income (pension/rental/dividend statements)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years initially, then convertible to permanent residency

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Paraguay). STATUS: DRAFT -- no minimum income figure is officially published (the source itself says so explicitly); migraciones.gov.py could not be fetched to check for a primary text. GENUINE, CURRENT FINDING: DNM Resolution 407/2026 (effective June 2026, three months before this build) tightened this route specifically -- a diploma or unverified claim of means is no longer accepted, actual documented and apostilled income proof is now required, category by category (employees need a labor contract, self-employed need an active RUC and IVA filings, foreign-income earners need apostilled attestations). This is a real, recent regulatory tightening, not this dataset's inference. citizenship_after_months (60) modeled from the general naturalization framework (see py_citizenship_naturalisation.json: 2 years temporary + 3 years permanent residency, per practitioner interpretation of Constitution Article 148's 'three years residency'), not a passive-income-specific provision.
